text:
Raj: Quick sync — Acme wants a Private/VPC POC with SSO (SAML) + dual-stack (v4/v6) support. They also asked for a firewall exceptions list and a short justification for PrivateLink vs VPC peering. Can NetOps + Security advise? cc @Leah :wave:

Leah: Short answers: PrivateLink gives easier egress control and isolates our service endpoints. VPC peering is cheaper but exposes cross-account routing and needs extra route management. Need to confirm if they require static egress IPs.

Mike: IPv6 note — our PrivateLink GA connector is IPv4-only. We have an experimental dual-stack path but it requires NAT64 on the customer side and additional validation. If customer MUST use native IPv6, we should flag as a blocker for PrivateLink GA.

Sam: Security Qs: 1) Do they want SAML traffic to flow over their private network only? 2) Any SOC2/legal redlines about asserting identities to our hosted control plane? If they want IdP traffic entirely inside their VPC we may need a private SAML proxy or to recommend Private deployment (customer-managed control plane).

Raj: They said "private-only SSO" in the security questionnaire. Sales noted a hard requirement: SAML assertion must not traverse internet-facing endpoints.

Leah: That pushes us toward Private (VPC) deployment or a short-term hybrid: PrivateLink for inference + customer runs a small SAML bridge in their VPC that talks to their IdP and our control plane over the PrivateLink tunnel. Ops will need firewall rules.

Mike: Firewall snippet for Customer (suggested minimal outbound rules):
```
# Allow from customer app subnet -> our PrivateLink endpoint VPC
TCP 443 to 34.200.128.0/24    # control-plane / auth callbacks
TCP 443 to 52.203.33.0/24     # model-serving egress (if hosted)
ICMP allow (type 8) to 34.200.128.0/24  # optional health checks
# If they require static-egress for callbacks: allow TCP 443 from our EIP pool (we'll share list)
```

Sam: Also include TLS SNI inspection note: if customer's firewall does TLS inspect, they must allow SNI passthrough or add our cert SAR. Otherwise SAML callbacks will fail.

Raj: Pricing question from the buyer: is there an extra per-hour or connector fee for PrivateLink?

Leah: Short: Private deployments are licensed (platform fee + support). PrivateLink connector (for hosted PrivateLink offering) has a monthly connector surcharge + per-GB egress. I'll paste the exact line from the pricing sheet in the follow-up thread.

Raj: OK. Can we get a quick checklist to hand to the customer network team so they can pre-provision? They want to run the POC next week.

Mike: Minimal POC network checklist: 1) Create VPC with /20 (or existing VPC) 2) Reserve subnets for connector (no public IPs needed) 3) Allow outbound HTTPS to our control-plane ranges (we'll share CIDRs) 4) If dual-stack required: provision NAT64 or IPv6-to-IPv4 translation and confirm routes 5) If SAML private-only: deploy SAML bridge VM with connectivity to IdP and our endpoints over PrivateLink

Sam: I'll attach a redlined answer to their security questionnaire after we sync with Legal. For now: mark SAML-private as HIGH risk if they expect hosted control-plane and insist traffic never leaves their network.

Raj: Can we get an Ops call today 3pm PT? I want NetOps and Solutions to join so we can produce the firewall snippet + short justification memo for the buyer.

Leah: I can do 3pm. @Mike @Sam?

Mike: I can make 3pm but please include the connector CIDR list — I'll bring it.

Sam: 3pm works. I'll bring the questionnaire and the list of acceptable encryption/key controls.

security-bot: Incidentally, customer raised a checkbox about "no shared IP with other customers" — PrivateLink satisfies isolation at the endpoint level but we still need to confirm dedicated-hosting options for full isolation. File a ticket if they require dedicated hardware. :lock:

Raj: Great — I'll schedule and send a concise pre-provision checklist to the buyer after the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
